notes.title: Graphics Upgrade Incoming – Version 0.6 Moves to URP
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="J5YcsFL6Zdo;full"][/previewyoutube]
Knights, the battlefield is about to look sharper than ever! 

In Version 0.6, we’re upgrading Legendary Knight’s rendering pipeline from Unity’s Built-in Renderer to the Universal Render Pipeline (URP). This change means:

Better Lighting & Shading – more vibrant and dynamic visuals

Improved Performance – smoother gameplay on a wider range of hardware

Future-Proof Graphics – opening the door for more visual upgrades down the road

This is a big step forward for the game’s visuals, and we can’t wait for you to experience the difference.

Stay tuned — Version 0.6 is on its way, and the legend is about to shine brighter than ever!

Oki Aki

notes.title: Legendary Knight – Update 0.5.0: A Grand Return
notes.notes:
In this update, I’ve made significant improvements to both the game’s visuals and stability.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/bd1c487e1fe03a264b07309fcff36675c8978648.jpg"]

The Main Menu UI has been completely redesigned to present a cleaner and more modern look, making it easier for players to navigate right from the start.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/5e00aa21bc35771e66281e3819539bbdeb32fcad.jpg"]

I’ve also updated the Barrack UI with improved visuals and better layout, allowing for a more intuitive and enjoyable experience when managing your units.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/5b4671f61f3d99943f4de6db9cdeebfbd97500fe.jpg"]

The in-game HUD has been refreshed to provide better readability, ensuring that important information is easier to track during gameplay without cluttering the screen.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/53f804c2636193ada73b0df6fb94076178f202d8.jpg"]

Finally, I’ve fixed numerous bugs across different parts of the game, improving the overall stability and ensuring smoother performance.



--

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/8ac5ae0f5c748b2ec06e88c60c7f20fd4f2b4d77.jpg"]Thank you all for your support since the release of Legendary Knight in 2020. After many years, I have finally returned to the path of indie game development. The last update for Legendary Knight was in 2022, and I never imagined I’d meet everyone again after such a long time. I hope you can drop by and check it out when you have the chance. I’m actively posting updates on various social media platforms, and I hope you will continue to support me.

Love,
Oki Aki @ Oki Game Lab

notes.title: Major update V0.4.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/36ea9637f6b0fabf7076f2e6069d81fb256403aa.png
Happy Lunar New Year! I wish you all good health and all the best!
Legendary Knight also welcomes the first major update on this happy day - Endless Mode is now available!
I have put a lot of effort into this update, almost like redoing the game all over again, that's why it took me so long to see you all again.

The following is the main content of version 0.4.0

New mode: endless city defense
Our defeat is certain, but we must win anyway. The enemy will continue to attack until the city is breached. Pick up your weapons and give the enemy the heaviest resist!
Or will the dawn comes?

New map
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/d2f7b639aae9ee8864bd50d83ca6acffb71f762a.png
As a summary of the Legendary Knight, a new map is necessary, larger battles, and more war-like scenarios.

Card system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/159bc33d1aedefcafca3603df17185ee44fb2320.png
Instead of the building upgrade system in the classic mode, players don't need to run back and forth in the map, faster game rhythm, more variety, and even allows players to perform special element attacks.

More character choices
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/4a4b3c7cb3b61aaea6db4c47464b7cc5b77ccd9a.png
With different unique attributes and auxiliary cards, choose the most suitable general for the city according to your battle style.

Building occupation system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/d9b3a2493e8c7ffc779c90310cbde2574ceefe6b.png
In the endless mode, the three functional buildings will be temporarily occupied by the enemy, and regaining controls will give you special buffs, allowing players to persist in this siege battle longer.

Scoring system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/689259e4781755982f916e266b100cb23348f643.jpg
Scores are given according to the player’s performance while defending the city. The evaluation elements include the number of enemies killed, time to stay, experience gained, and the number of soldiers killed. 

Thank you for your support

PS: About the master DLC situation
Due to the time required for approval, the master in endless mode cannot be unlocked temporarily, please be patient

notes.title: Legendary Knight V0.3.2 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/b284fc7bd7915fcbdd4757c07a92e83c6cb1315a.png
Legendary Knight V0.3.2 update (2020-07-09):
1. Soldiers have their own names
Now the soldier's name will be displayed above the soldier. Some names are shown in yellow, representing some of the partners who directly participated in the Oki Game Lab's productions.

2. Auto-cancel sprinting after attack
In the past version player will not stop the stamina cost and sprinting after a sprint attack. The problem has been solved.

3. Better designed Soldier Health bar
The original health bar was really disgusting, and now the icons of the types of soldiers and some minor changes have been added, which will not hurt your eyes anymore.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Legendary Knight V0.3.1 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/de100813e1c33abe58ea40dbbdbd34ec9e61c2ec.png
Legendary Knights V0.3.1 Update (2020-06-18).
[olist]
(Fixed) Soldiers in Fortress Mine teleport to the wall
(Fixed) Enemies fall off from the dock in Village wave 16
(Fixed) King's HP Level II skills invalid conditions
(Fixed) Fortress Victory Screen Problem
Adding Sensitivity option
Options will be saved automatically
The skip function will be temporarily locked during a shopping pause
[/olist]

1. Soldiers in Fortress Mine teleport to the wall
At the fortress map, soldiers appeared to fly up to the wall, and the problem is now under control, but not fully resolved. But at least I gave them a way to get back to the ground after they flew up.

2. Enemies fall off from the dock in Village wave 16
Soldiers sometimes fall out of the dock because of problems with the development software. Now there is a way to deal with those unfortunate soldiers who fall into the water and let them return to the map.

3. King's HP Level II skills invalid conditions
The problem has been fixed.

4. Game options update
Sensitivity adjustments have been added and all options changes by the player will be saved automatically.

5. The skip function will be temporarily locked during a shopping pause
Now if the player is in a store, they cannot skip the prep time in order to prevent the previous screen freezing issue.

Thank you for your support!

Legendary Knight V0.3.0 Updates (2020-04-18):
[olist]
 Full support for the French interface
 New main menu design
 The King can push his soldiers
 Enemy Knights will not dodge
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/d63c348792e7d72d4fad5bf58f0cf8b5add65545.png
1. Full support for the French interface (Thx Mathiue)
Starting from V0.3.0, the game will be fully supported in French, and new players can also set the default game language to French via Steam's settings. Thanks to Mathiue, our Discord administrator. He is from France and has prepared everything for this new change. 

2. New main menu design
We have a new main menu design. This is in preparation for the next new game mode.

3. The King can push his soldiers (Thx Orbnotacus)
During the game, we were often blocked in the battlefield by our own men. Now the king can push his men away and move on.

4. Enemy Knights will not dodge (Thx Orbnotacus)
Knights in full plate armor, and armed with great swords, sometimes appear too powerful. Our king is even more powerless when they block his attacks and then flamboyantly dodge his second and third attacks.  With this in mind, we issue a new instruction to all knights, do not dodge in battle!

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Legendary Knight V0.2.2 Update
notes.notes:
Legendary Knight V0.2.2 Updates (2020-03-28):
[olist]
 Use items with number keys
 Damage effect
 Default control adjustment
[/olist]

This update is about controls

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/f728c42bd1cafd803a16a30203c5aef1ffd8dfd2.png
1. Use items with number keys (Thx nado)
Now you can use items with number keys. The idea is to allow users to stick their hand on the mouse so that they don't have to control anything with arrow keys. Hope this feature will help.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/fb6096e1694f6714f2e1a7eca6519dd55c0960f2.png
2. Damage effect
Damage effects now appear with every attack. Players can see the damage caused by each attack more clearly.

3. Default control adjustment (Thx Orbnotacus)
We have adjusted a few default control in this version:
 - Scroll wheel to change weapons (replace left / right arrows)
 - Scroll wheel button to use strong attack (replace num 1)
 - Q to open command panel (replace Space)
 - Space to roll (replace Q)

notes.title: Legendary Knight V0.1.3 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/f1d19622217813f0f7cb215ad1f9b603e89727fb.png
Legendary Knight V0.1.3 Updates (2020-03-03):
[olist]
 Shopping Pause
 Invert Y
 Now can use ESC key to close popups (Shops and command panel)
 Skills that cannot be researched yet will display being locked
 Now item shop will show how many items you have in the moment.
[/olist]

This version update is all about enhancement of shops.

1. Shopping Pause (Thx Commander)
I have noticed that it is very difficult for new player to finish all actions in just 50 seconds. So now I have added a feature that when player enter a shop (item, skills, building upgrade or barrack), the game will stop. You can disable this feature in settings in case you would like to challenge yourself.

2. Invert Y (Thx Redlovedfr)
Now players can enable invert-Y in Options.

3. ESC key can close popups
To be honest, even I make mistake sometimes when I want to close a shop, I press the ESC key. Now you can close both shop popups and command panel with the ESC key.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/15b3398de21aacd8c8178f390dd7a2d5220a3d04.png
4. Locked the skills that cannot be researched yet
A better display to let you know those skills cannot be reached yet. I put a little lock on it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36810436/cf3821918d01161ed094e2e0abd3a70a225152b3.png
5. Item shop will show how many items you have in the moment
Players have a hard time when buying items that they don't know how many army potions are in their pocket. You will have no problem with it anymore. Amounts are shown in the item shop.

Damn...... I push myself to finish all these features within a short period of time. Because I understand that some of the problems really hurt the user experience. Now I need some sleep..... If you have any questions or looking for enhancements, feel free to leave your comments here or in the forum.

Thanks for your support!
